units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:32">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>לְבוּשׁוֹ מצרי</he> his dress was Egyptian.
Ukts. I, 2 הל׳ שלה the husk of the wheat grain; a. fr.—Pl. לְבוּשִׁים, לְבוּשִׁין.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 90b:20">Snh. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>צדיקים שנקברין בלְבוּשֵׁיהֶן</he> the righteous who are buried in their garments, v. <cite ref="P01326"><he>עָרוֹם</he></cite>; (<cite ref="Ketubot 111b:10">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>במלבושיהן</he>).

<cite ref="Megillah 16b:1">Meg. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>חמשה לְבוּשֵׁי מלכות</he> five official garments; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1059:6">Yalk. Esth. 1059</cite> <he>לבושים של מלכות</he>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M01477"><he>מַלְבּוּשׁ</he></cite>.
